blocks: International School Bangkok: Thailand’s First International School
Welcome to International School Bangkok (ISB), the premier international school in Thailand and a benchmark for educational excellence in Asia.

Founded in 1951 on the grounds of the United States Embassy, ISB was established to serve the U.S. diplomatic community and has evolved over more than 70 years into one of the most respected international schools in the region. As a proudly independent and not-for-profit school, we reinvest entirely in what matters most: the growth and well-being of our students. Located within the safe, vibrant community of Nichada Thani, ISB offers families a balanced, high quality of life and a welcoming home just outside the bustle of Bangkok.

As a leading American school in Thailand, ISB combines a US-based curriculum with globally recognized AP and IB pathways. Shaped by an American educational philosophy and a truly global outlook, ISB offers an accredited international curriculum grounded in inquiry, critical thinking, and student agency. We empower students to define for themselves who they are and where they want to go. Very few schools can offer this level of genuinely personalized education, preparing students with the intellectual rigor, personal confidence, and sense of global responsibility required to thrive.
Learn More Inquire or Apply here
Over 60 nationalities, one community. Our diverse, multilingual environment prepares students to excel in an interconnected world.
Inclusive by design. Everyone is welcome at ISB. We prioritize student agency, shaping our curriculum around the learner, not the other way around.
Pre-K to Grade 12 in one world-class campus. Conveniently located just outside the city, our unified campus fosters a seamless educational journey and a deep sense of belonging.

International School Bangkok offers a comprehensive educational journey from Pre-Kindergarten (age 3) to Grade 12. We provide an expansive range of subjects and clearly defined university pathways designed to meet the unique aspirations of every student. In High School, students may pursue IB Diploma, ISB Diploma, AP courses, or thoughtfully designed hybrid pathways – mentored by expert educators who prioritize both academic success and personal well-being.

Our international school’s key academic divisions include Early Childhood, where a Reggio Emilia-inspired, play-based curriculum nurtures curiosity and essential foundational skills. Elementary School follows, building a strong, balanced foundation for literacy, numeracy, and social-emotional growth. Our Middle School employs a globally-minded approach that encourages students to explore their interests through critical thinking, collaboration, and leadership. Finally, the High School offers advanced IB and AP programs, meticulously designed to prepare students for university success and a balanced, purposeful life.

From state-of-the-art athletics facilities, performance art theaters fit for professionals, design and robotics labs, visual art labs, libraries, and much more. We cater to everyone and almost every program here at ISB.

pages.title: About ISB - International School Bangkok, Premier International School in Thailand since 1951
blocks: Choosing the right school for your child is one of the most important decisions a family can make. It shapes academic progress, relationships, and a child's sense of belonging over time. It is a responsibility that requires balancing academic ambition with personal wellbeing and long-term perspective.

In Thailand, families have access to a wide range of high-quality schools. As children grow, develop new interests, and discover their strengths, it becomes essential to choose an environment that can support those changes while continuing to provide appropriate challnge and continuity.

For families relocating internationally, the idea of "the right fit" often extends beyond the classroom. Quality of family life, a secure and welcoming community, and a curriculum with global transferability sit alongside academic outcomes, friendships, and wellbeing. Ultimately, the right choice is found where educational quality and community culture align in a way that feels right for both the child and the family.

If you have arrived at this page seeking clarity, we hope it offers a clear sense of who we are at International School Bangkok - as a school and as a community. When you're ready, we invite you to connect with our Admissions team, who are here to listen, answer questions, and support you as you navigate your decision with confidence.

International School Bangkok (ISB) is the premier international school in Thailand, serving a diverse community of students from more than 60 nationalities. Founded on May 14, 1951, as the International Children's Centre, ISB is Thailand's first international school.

Our journey began in a single wooden building on the grounds of the United States Embassy, with 50 students in the early primary years. In those formative days, teaching was led by dedicated volunteer parents, establishing a strong sense of shared responsibility that continues to influence the school today. As ISB grew, it became an important center for the international community in Bangkok, earning a reputation for educational quality and stability during a period of significant global change. Over time, this growth enabled ISB to develop into one of Southeast Asia's most respected international schools.

Today, ISB serves approximately 1,700 students on a purpose-built campus set within a tropical environment. While the scale and setting have evolved, the spirit of ISB has remained constant. As an independent, not-for-profit institution guided by clear values for more than 70 years, ISB remains committed to academic excellence, global understanding, and preparing students thoughtfully for what comes next.
We prepare students to become leaders in meeting the ever-changing needs of the world and equip them with the knowledge and skills to become caring global citizens.
